title: 🎨 The Art Studio Mystery
intro: Whiskers, Luna, Oliver, and Bella are busy in the art studio, each with a favorite way to create and a favorite color to use. Can you figure out who's painting with what?
clues: Luna's medium is not Painting, Sculpture, or Collage.
Bella does not love Blue or Yellow.
Whoever loves Green also loves Collage.
Whoever loves Red also loves Sculpture.
hints: Clue 2 rules out three mediums for Luna all at once — whatever's left is her answer.
Clue 7 gives you Luna's color directly: Yellow. Mark it!
Clues 4 and 5 don't name a cat — they link a color straight to a medium. Once you know a cat's medium, check whether it matches either of those.
Clue 3 leaves Bella only two color choices. Try combining it with clue 5 (Red → Sculpture) to see which medium Bella needs to have for Red to work.
Once Bella and Luna are settled, clues 1 and 6 will help you sort out Whiskers and Oliver for what's left.
